$comment: Compatibility sweep round 23 list (compiled by Android compat round 26): the next 30 Chrome Web Store extensions by install count after the top 30 of round 1, the 30 of next30.json and the 30 of each of next30-round3.json to next30-round22.json (ranks 661-690; manifests under the project store internal/extensions/next30-round23/). Counts are the store detail pages' rounded figures read 2026-10-01; ties inside one rounded bucket are ordered by the page's rating count, equal rounded rating counts by name. Candidates came from the store's category listings and keyword searches, about 26,830 detail pages probed across rounds 3 to 23 (this round read the store's 20 listings and 653 search terms - round 17's 548 and 105 new - again: 4,079 ids, 126 new detail pages, the largest of them at 40,000 users, none at the bucket). Round 22's list took the rounded 200,000 bucket's next 30 by rating count down to YouTube Dual Subtitles at 1,300, so every unlisted candidate at or above the rounded 100,000 bucket (659 detail pages by the pool's stored figures: 26 above 600,000, 2 at 600,000, 2 at 500,000, 4 at 400,000, 5 at 300,000, 151 at 200,000 and 469 at 100,000) was read again on 2026-10-01, the day of this list's read; against the pool's stored figures the same sixteen user counts differ that rounds 21 and 22 recorded, and the list ranks the re-read figures: up one bucket DocsAfterDark, Automation 360 and History Shortcut - Fast History Button from 100,000 to 200,000 (474, 7 and 4 ratings - below the cut); down one bucket Link Grabber and SciSpace from 300,000 to 200,000 (261 and 144 ratings - below the cut), Extension Manager, Instant Gaming and Points Path for Google Flights from 200,000 to 100,000, and WEB.DE MailCheck, Seamless.AI, NotebookLM Tools for Gemini Notebook, Aircall Dialer, Music Mode for YouTube, Designer Tools, Meet Extension and BattleTabs from 100,000 to 70,000-90,000 (below the bucket) - and 27 detail pages published no user count on two reads (at the bucket Gale In Context: Opposing Viewpoints and Education Pro Browser Extension MV3 at 300,000, and NetSupport School Student, IntoWords Cloud, Assessment Lock (Vretta), Sophos Chrome Security, Single Sign-on Assistant and SAP Enable Now at 200,000 - organisation-managed items whose rating counts, 112 and fewer, fall below the cut in any case; classroom.cloud Student, Bark for Chrome Watchdog, Stop Motion Animator and the store's own Chrome Web Store item at 100,000; the other 15 organisation-managed items, Chrome Apps or themes above the bucket), so their stored figures stand, as round 23 ruled for such pages. The buckets at and above 300,000 hold no unlisted rankable item (the themes, Chrome Apps and organisation-managed items named below); ranks 661-690 are the rounded 200,000 bucket's next 30 items by rating count - Auto Clicker - AutoFill (1,200), SwiftRead - read faster, learn more (1,200; equal rounded rating counts, so by name), DXF Viewer (1,100), Octotree - GitHub code tree (1,100; equal, so by name), Tab Manager Plus for Chrome (1,100; equal, so by name), Adblock Bear - stop invasive ads (1,000), Image Downloader - picture and photos saver (1,000; equal, so by name), YouTube Anti Translate (992), Auto Clicker (971), Notifier for Gmail (965), Just Read (910), Eightify: AI YouTube Summarizer (859), Picture in Picture - Floating player (855), Notepad (823), Quick Javascript Switcher (819), PDF Editor for Chrome:Edit, Fill, Sign, Print (801), SEO Minion (796), zkPass TransGate (769), Screenity - Screen Recorder & Annotation Tool (762), Shopify Spy & Dropshipping - Koala Inspector (748), Ibotta: Price compare, cashback, item alerts (741), ApkOnline APK manager for Android emulator (723), AI Content Detector - Copyleaks (708), TickTick - Todo & Task List (707), Zoom to Fill - Ultrawide Video (691), Bookmarks clean up (679), User JavaScript and CSS (662), Google Search Maps Button (659), DeepSider: AI Sidebar (651) and Selectext: Copy Text from Videos (643) - and the cut falls between Selectext at 643 ratings and iGuge at 635 (Add to MyRegistry.com Button at 630, META SEO inspector at 628 and WA Sender - Bulk Messages & Automation at 627 behind it). None holds funds (zkPass TransGate is a zero-knowledge attestation client with a sandboxed page, an offscreen document and snarkjs WASM; its popup imports or creates an SBT behind a Secret Recovery Phrase - key material, read as a wallet-like onboarding, not a funds wallet); Auto Clicker - AutoFill, Screenity, Koala Inspector (identity and identity.email) and AI Content Detector - Copyleaks carry the identity permission, and Notifier for Gmail, Eightify, zkPass TransGate, Koala Inspector, Ibotta, AI Content Detector, TickTick and DeepSider ask for a signed-in site or their services - ranked as earlier lists ranked Grammarly and HubSpot Sales. None replaces the new-tab page, none carries chrome_settings_overrides, none is a native-messaging companion. Two rows have no background at all (YouTube Anti Translate: five content scripts and a popup that doubles as the options page; Google Search Maps Button: one content script and activeTab, 9 KB in all), two carry a MAIN-world content script on <all_urls> (Auto Clicker - AutoFill, Zoom to Fill), four open a side panel (Auto Clicker - AutoFill, AI Content Detector, TickTick, DeepSider), two carry the userScripts permission (Auto Clicker - AutoFill, User JavaScript and CSS), Quick Javascript Switcher the contentSettings permission, Screenity tabCapture (desktopCapture optional), Ibotta the background permission, Selectext browsingData, Zoom to Fill declarativeNetRequestWithHostAccess, and Octotree, Quick Javascript Switcher, TickTick, Zoom to Fill and User JavaScript and CSS name a minimum Chrome version (88 to 120). The rows carry the manifests' names, which match the store's listings for 29 of the 30; the store lists Image Downloader - picture and photos saver as "Image downloader - picture and photos saver". Not ranked: themes (Morpheon Dark, Dark Theme for Google Chrome, Sea Foam), Chrome Apps (Google Classroom, Postman), organisation-managed or organisation-login-only items (the list of round 21's comment - ClassLink OneClick, Clever, Endpoint Verification, Mobility Print, Lightspeed Insight Agent, Okta Browser Plugin, Trellix Endpoint Security Web Control, LearnPlatform for Students, OpenText Content Server Browser Web Extension, Pix Companion, Snow Web Application Metering, My Apps Secure Sign-in Extension, MasteryConnect LockDown Browser, HID Credential Management Extension, LanSchool Web Helper, iboss Cloud Connector, RapidIdentity, Browser Security Plus, Browser Redirection Extension, ActivID CMS extension, Britannica School Insights, Idira Identity Browser Extension, Citrix Web Extension, Securly for Chromebooks, Cegid Peoplenet ClickOnce launcher, Omnissa Horizon URL Content Redirection Helper, CXone Agent WebRTC Extension, iboss Classroom Management for Students, Chrome Reporting Extension, JumpCloud Go, Education Pro Browser Extension MV3, Gale In Context: Opposing Viewpoints) and Google items whose detail pages publish no user count.
